snippet.title: Ratchet & Clank: Going Commando - Full Game Playthrough | Pure Gameplay (PS3, No Commentary)
snippet.description:
Hey everyone, this is my full game playthrough for Ratchet & Clank: Going Commando, running on the PS3 with no added commentary.

Here's a couple of ways you could support the channel 🙂; 
► Liking and commenting on the video if you enjoyed it ✔
► Becoming a subscriber (https://www.youtube.com/c/FullPlaythroughs?sub_confirmation=1) ✔
► Tipping with a super thanks ✔

Thanks for watching! Comment below if you have any full playthrough suggestions or if you want to contribute to the channel as well!
